text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I spot Curren Chan at a
cafe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I ordered the new flavor! Hopefully I'll
do a good
job reviewing it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's looking at her phone on the table
and
talking to herself...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's it for part A. The next thing
I need to
film is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro? Fancy seeing you here!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis? Fancy seeing you here!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the video just now? I'm uploading it
to
UmaTube!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
UmaTube is a video-sharing service
that's popular
with people of all ages. I
had no idea Curren
Chan was on
UmaTube as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Do you hear yourself? I'm doing
both, of
course!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I actually made my UmaTube channel a
long time
ago. I just hadn't really been
giving it much
attention.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But now I'm gonna be posting a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna be the most beloved runner, I
have to
get more people to know who I
am.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Since there are so many people watching

UmaTube, I figure posting there is pretty

important. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sooo... don't forget to subscribe to
Curren
Channel ♪!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sooo... don't forget to subscribe to
Curren
Channel ♪!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll walk you through it. First, you have
to make an
account...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for subscribing. ♪ Now that my

UmaTube's all set...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to follow me on UmaTok and
Umatter
too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm gonna be posting on
those next! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I really recommend this cafe's
special latte! I'll
show you how to order
it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though I came to this cafe to get a
drink, I
end up helping with Curren
Chan's posting on
social media.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time for a funny-face contest! Ready,
go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Teehee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Grrr...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Show me the vid.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Show me the vid.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All right! ♪ I think this one's okay for
UmaTok!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh. Your arms are shaking... I guess you were holding my phone for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh. Your arms are shaking... I guess you were holding my phone for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for doing like 107 retakes. But
thanks to
you, I got a good one!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've filmed the dance too, it's
time to
post on Umatter!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I usually just use Umatter as a way to get
people
to check out my UmaTube and
Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But since the audiences are different,
there are
some pics I only upload
there. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Oh, this lighting's perfect!
Quick—get a pic!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Oh, this lighting's perfect!
Quick—get a pic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flash! Flash! Flash!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Now to add a caption... Aaand
post!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I check out her post right away. It's a
picture of
her smiling indifferently in
front of the setting sun
with the caption,
"Let's go on another date soon."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's just a regular picture of Curren Chan,
but the
speed at which it gets attention
is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That might be a new record!
Having
someone else take the shot
really does
wonders. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It seems like maybe Umatter users like
having a
story attached to the upload!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you just post a pic with a short
sentence, you
get more attention than if
you try too hard for it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it myself, but it looks
like she
uses each platform differently.
But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After spending just one day with her,
I've realized
that posting on social media
is much more
difficult than I'd imagined.
I'd prefer if she
concentrated that
energy solely on her races.
choice_data_list: You didn't have to beat the record by that much...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...You think?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm completely fine, though.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm completely fine, though.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Posting on social media is my calling,
and getting
to interact with everyone
really refreshes me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So don't worry about me. Just look
forward to the
Aoi Stakes, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So don't worry about me. Just look
forward to the
Aoi Stakes, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can feel an intense pressure behind her
bright
smile... I don't think she'll let me
say anything
else.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I've gotta post to Umastagram soon.
Stay
with me till I'm done, 'kay?
Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I've gotta post to Umastagram soon.
Stay
with me till I'm done, 'kay?
Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It ends up being a day spent taking tons
of
pictures... My worries, unfortunately,
are never
addressed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#CuteCurrenChan #AoiStakes
#RightBefore
#JapaneseDerby
#CheerForMe ♪"
